# Mohit Dhawan

Data scientist and ML engineer in Bengaluru. Founding ML engineer at Providio. Works across three fields: agentic AI, NLP, and classical ML and statistics.

Contact: mohit.dhawan2510@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohit-dhawan98/

Writing: https://themlnerd.substack.com

## Fields

- Agentic AI: harnesses, tools and memory around a model, and the evaluation that says whether a change helped. Open work: sre-incident-env, 8 production incident patterns, 4 frontier models baselined.
- NLP: entity recognition, document parsing, classification, semantic similarity, fine-tuned language models.
- Classical ML and statistics: two-sided matching, price elasticity, demand forecasting, root-cause models, A/B tests.

## Work

- Providio, Founding ML engineer, now. Providio OS, an agent platform for airline revenue and marketing analytics. Public write-up: https://providio.ai/blogs/intro-to-providio-os
- Prismforce, Senior Data Scientist, 2025 to 2026. Matching job demand to people with a skill recognition model and a skill-job knowledge graph: 30% less client onboarding time, matching over 40% faster and 70% more accurate. A resume and job description parser.
- CommerceIQ, Data Scientist 2, 2022 to 2024. Automated product classification: 80% less onboarding time, $3M additional revenue. SKU matching across retailers: 80% fewer manual operations, 40% less matching load. A universal classifier as a service. A sales root-cause model: $200K additional ARR.
- Reliance Jio, Data Scientist, 2021 to 2022. Price elasticity API for AJIO: 15% better sales-to-inventory ratio. Demand forecasting: 3% better accuracy. Dynamic pricing experiments. SHAP-based explanation of black-box models, published as a conference paper.
- Independent. From best match to mutual match: mutual acceptance from 22% to 68% for an AI matchmaking app. sre-incident-env, resolve-free-mcp, Recall.
